en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large group of men, women, and children on a wooden pier or boardwalk, posed closely together for a formal photograph. Most adults wear early 20th‑century clothing: suits, ties, and boater or flat caps for men; long skirts, light coats, and wide‑brimmed or cloche‑style hats for women. Several children are seated in front, some in sailor outfits. Behind the crowd, on a hillside, stand numerous wooden villas and resort-style buildings, including a prominent large hotel or sanatorium overlooking the town. The setting suggests a coastal or resort town in a temperate climate. No visible text or caption appears on the image side.
